Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.exception

Class MigrationChecksumException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
java.lang.IllegalStateException
org.aristonis.diwan.database.exception.MigrationChecksumException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class MigrationChecksumException extends IllegalStateException
Refuses a run because a migration that already ran no longer matches the checksum recorded for it.

A migration that was edited after it ran has not changed the database it already changed, so the code and the schema have drifted apart. The message lists every such migration with the recorded and the current checksum. To fix it, restore the migration to the text that ran and add a new migration for the change; Migrator.repairChecksums(List) is for recovery only. Nothing ran when this is thrown.
